desc: Implement prime-modulus solution (M = p = k·N + 1 prime, A = x^k mod p, exactness checked via the distinct prime factors of N) with N=1 handled, deterministic 64-bit Miller–Rabin, and Pollard-rho factoring of N.
Verify correctness: outputs satisfy ord(A)=N for N=3, 16, 1, 55; general construction is provably valid for all N.
Confirmed performance is comfortable for T=1e4.
